classification_rationale: A trigger (ecrecover/signature-verification library usage) is buildable, but 'properly verify signatures to ensure authenticity' is a broad correctness property covering many distinct failure modes (missing signer checks, wrong hash construction, missing zero-address checks on ecrecover failure, etc.) -- no single narrow semantic condition captures it the way req-2-verify-exact-balance-check's 'protect against transfers' does. Closer in character to req-2-check-rounding than to the narrower override-pair requirements.
